description.value: Thai by Thai is a sit-down and pickup Thai restaurant on Scott Road (120 St) in Surrey, offering an extensive menu of curries, noodle dishes, and stir-fries alongside lunch specials. The restaurant has earned 209 customer reviews and operates a fully functional online ordering system for pickup. Cyclists riding the Surrey/Delta corridor will find it a convenient stop for a hot meal or a quick takeout order.
